# GENERATED by tools/reconcile/emit_artifacts.py from redirects.json - do not hand-edit

Every file in apply/ is derived from ../redirects.json (89 rules
+ the host catch-all). Regenerate with:

    python3 tools/reconcile/emit_artifacts.py

cloudflare_bulk_redirects.csv - import at Cloudflare Account Home ->
Bulk Redirects -> Create Bulk Redirects list -> Import CSV. Pure data
rows (no header, no comments - the importer accepts neither). Columns:
source_url, target_url, status_code, preserve_query_string,
include_subdomains, subpath_matching, preserve_path_suffix. The final
row is the host catch-all (subpath matching on) - keep it last in the
list so per-path rules win.

htaccess_okccosmeticsurgeon.txt - Apache fallback for the current
legacy origin.

cloudfront_function.js - CloudFront Function (viewer-request) fallback
for the practice-stack ship path.
